summary.text: Thomas West is the Republican candidate for Pennsylvania State Senate District 38 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His campaign website describes him as a Pennsylvania native, small-business owner and former television news producer.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, Thomas West has run TRIM Pittsburgh for more than a decade and spent 15 years producing local television news before that.
The site says he lives in Highland Park.
West advanced from the May 19, 2026 Republican primary.
His campaign lists three priorities: affordable living, safe communities and responsible growth.
